question: If South-East becomes North, then what will North-East become ?
solution:
The logic follows here is:

The original directions are

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cd28dcc7c4bfa267f9994c12dcef6a8fb00db00cc36e79ed4a886e5404e5564.png] 

The direction is rotating 135° anticlockwise. 

After changing direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/417629dd6008b1bc8d9a55c776819c182c2ef38a4a7b30c6e2e758da69979761.png] 

South-East becomes North,

Similarly,

North-East becomes West after rotating 135° anticlockwise.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
